mechanics.claim: The nova hits nearby enemies on cast and, if it hits at least one enemy champion, triggers Overcharged.
mechanics.quote: discharges an electric nova that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. If this hits at least one enemy champion, she enters ''Overcharged'' for 5 seconds.

mechanics.claim: During Overcharged, Burst Fire fires 3 rounds instead of the normal burst, and the first round to hit an enemy per cast chains to up to 4 additional targets for bonus physical damage that can crit.
mechanics.quote: instead fires 3 rounds that travel with increased speed. The first round to hit an enemy per {{tip|cast instance}} chains electricity to the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy within 650 units of the target, up to 4 subsequent targets, to deal {{as|40% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}. This damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|40}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Zeri gains 1 Hypercharged stack per champion hit with an ability or charged attack during Overcharged, increased to 3 on critically striking abilities.
mechanics.quote: She generates 1 stack for each one she hits with an ability or ''{{ai|Living Battery|Zeri|charged}}'' attack, increased to 3 on abilities that {{tip|critically strike}}.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the initial nova but does not prevent Zeri from entering Overcharged.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} blocks ''Lightning Crash's'' initial nova but does not prevent '''Zeri''' from becoming ''Overcharged''.

mechanics.claim: The nova applies as area damage and the chain lightning applies as proc damage (a separate damage instance per hit).
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|area damage}} for the nova and {{tip|proc damage}} for the chain lightning.

mechanics.claim: Zeri can move during the ability's cast time.
mechanics.quote: '''''Zeri''' can move during Lightning Crash's cast time.''
